content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IPA Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.ipa.org.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 18-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IPA recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Indian Ports Association recruitment is 18th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree (full-time) or above from a reputed university in fields like Economics, Public Policy, Maritime, Trade, Transport Management, or International Relations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Consultant and Consultant positions?
faq.answer: The age limit for both Senior Consultant and Consultant positions is between 25 to 45 years. Specific age relaxations are not detailed in the provided information.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for Senior Consultant and Consultant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies, with 2 positions for Senior Consultant and 3 positions for Consultant.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The Senior Consultant will receive ₹15,00,000/- per annum, while the Consultant will receive ₹12,00,000/- per annum.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications through speed post or registered post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the tenure of the contract for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions are on a contractual basis for an initial period of 2 years. No changes in remuneration will be considered during this initial period.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the IPA's official website, www.ipa.org.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the work experience required for the Consultant post?
faq.answer: For the Consultant position, a minimum of 3 years of full-time work experience post-essential education is required.

faq.question: Q10. What is the work experience required for the Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: For the Senior Consultant position, a minimum of 5 years of full-time work experience post-essential education is required.
